items.q: So we played first, Lloyd Hunter's band. And after we played, did our numbers, then Nat Towles came on.

ctx.x: Good. So this is the night that's going to be the battle.

This is the night of the battle. So we played first, Lloyd Hunter's band. And after we played, did our numbers, then Nat Towles came on. And when Nat came on, he had all these good arrangements and these good musicians, but that band just didn't swing on account of the drummer.
